summary.text: Meg Kilcoyne is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Worcester District who has held the seat since January 6, 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She previously worked as a legislative aide.

paragraphs.text: Meghan Kilcoyne was born in Sterling, Massachusetts, graduated from Wachusett Regional High School, and earned a B.A. in history from Stonehill College.

Her career experience includes working as the legislative director and chief budget analyst for former State Representative Harold Naughton Jr., whom she succeeded in the 12th Worcester District seat in 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session she is vice chair of the Health Care Financing Joint Committee and also serves on House Ways and Means and the Judiciary Joint Committee.
